description: This file defines the class Zend_XmlRpc_Response, which handles creating, loading, and managing XML-RPC response messages, including fault responses and value serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Response
classes.description: A class for managing XML-RPC responses, including encoding, value handling, fault detection, and XML serialization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the response with optional return value and type.

methods.name: setEncoding
methods.description: Sets the character encoding for the response and updates the encoding in related value objects.

methods.name: getEncoding
methods.description: Returns the current response character encoding.

methods.name: setReturnValue
methods.description: Sets the return value and optional type hint for the response.

methods.name: _getXmlRpcReturn
methods.description: Internal method to get the XML-RPC representation of the return value.

methods.name: isFault
methods.description: Checks if the response represents a fault condition.

methods.name: getFault
methods.description: Returns the fault object if the response is a fault.

methods.name: loadXml
methods.description: Parses an XML string to load the response, detecting whether it is a fault or a valid response.

methods.name: saveXml
methods.description: Serializes the response to an XML string.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Generates the XML string representation of the response.
